items.value: When is insulin needed in diabetes?

items.label: Insulin is always needed in type 1 diabetes, and is used in type 2 or
items.value: Insulin is always needed in type 1 diabetes, and is used in type 2 or gestational diabetes when other treatments don't bring blood sugar to target, or in certain situations like illness, surgery, or pregnancy.

items.label: How can diabetes affect the kidneys?
items.value: How can diabetes affect the kidneys?

items.label: Long-term high blood sugar can gradually damage the small blood vessel
items.value: Long-term high blood sugar can gradually damage the small blood vessels in the kidneys, which is why regular kidney function and urine protein checks are part of diabetes care.
